answer: Each applicant is issued one sealed nectar vial and must fly a published falcon route that touches three unaffiliated grove feeders, each of which stamps a time and a hash of (vial id + applicant address + epoch seed). A seat opens only if the three stamps are in route order, at least twenty minutes apart, and the vial id is unredeemed. Reused vials, cloned feeder stamps, or tight clusters of applicants sharing one feeder set burn those seats, and those keys are barred from the next two routes.
